human_intent: Execute recovery lane R07 completely: recover durable capability lineage for PageKit / Class Player / whiteboard across versions, including laser, whiteboard, Wacom/stylus evidence, curves, eraser, tabs and fullscreen; detect regressions without collapsing distinct owners; persist enough state that future agents do not need historical chats.
already_decided: This workstream owns R07 recovery knowledge and coordination only; it is not a replacement PageKit product owner.
Current/Catalog/Lineage authority remains external to this recovery workstream.
pagekit-v26 is the stable-class-player rollback donor / positive rollback fossil in Lineage.
pagekit-v37 is a capability candidate whose laser transform tracking is best-known, while its whole UX is not Human Accepted.
The Psicoanálisis PageKit surface is a distinct consumer/integration artifact and must not be silently treated as the owner of the Class Player lineage.
Do not infer Human Accepted, Current or Served state from version number, catalog liveness or a recovered file.
high_value_targets: Persist a capability/version/regression matrix from exact durable artifacts.
Separate stable baseline, later candidate gains and consumer-specific PageKit behavior.
Preserve negative knowledge around eraser safety, undo, tabs/objects, laser tracking and authority boundaries.
Classify Wacom/stylus and fullscreen claims by actual code evidence rather than chat memory.
Leave a compact LAST_RETURN and a cross-workstream delta only if it changes other workers' decisions.
known_failures: Treating V37 as globally superior merely because it is later than V26.
Collapsing Psicoanálisis PageKit sheet tabs with V37 multi-board/object semantics.
Inferring Wacom pressure/button support from generic PointerEvent code.
Calling responsive/full-viewport layouts 'Fullscreen API' without implementation evidence.
Reintroducing hover erasure instead of pressed-only eraser semantics.
Using inaccessible historical chat claims to fill missing version history.

refresh_contract.same_epoch: Continue without reading NETWORK/DELTA; do not recompile context.
refresh_contract.new_epoch: Reload only this compiled packet; it already contains filtered relevant changes.

FAST.use_when: The requested change is explicit, local, reversible and does not require material architectural decisions.
forbidden_overhead: release receipts for ordinary LAB iteration

DEEP.use_when: The task is materially ambiguous, multi-file, design-heavy or benefits from deciding the space before editing.
sequence: CONTEXT FIRST: write the material understanding that can change execution
COMPLETE MAP: name all meaningful parts before diving into part one
DEVELOP: resolve important decisions under those headings
EXECUTE: implement as much of the map as tool/context boundaries allow
CRITIQUE: inspect the actual result for contradictions and lost value
REPAIR: fix worker-soluble failures in the same work cycle
DEEP.rule: Context/map/specification are decision compression, not deliverables to endlessly regenerate.

EXHAUSTIVE.use_when: The human explicitly requests exhaustive coverage/a numbered map, or the work is structural enough that omission risk dominates.
sequence: print the complete requested title map once
develop it at the requested depth
execute continuously from the frozen frontier
rules: A requested count such as 100 is a coverage matrix, not permission for filler.
After PLAN:FROZEN, later turns must not regenerate the same plan.
N/A or DEFER with a reason is better than fake work.
A response-length boundary is not a project boundary; persist the frontier and continue.

CONTINUE.use_when: The conversation already has a materially sufficient context/map/specification or the human sends dot to continue.

automatic_selection.explicit_exhaustive_or_existing_frozen_l: EXHAUSTIVE or CONTINUE when already frozen
